limitations: Reduced-motion paths implemented and code-reviewed but not emulated in a browser
Hero runner and film are AI-generated with Higgsfield (GPT Image 2.6 + Seedance 2.5, 720p) from prompts; runner cut-out is 730x952 so it is slightly soft on very large retina screens

Film scrub uses a same-origin MP4 (preload auto) instead of a Blob URL: Blob-backed media never finished seeking in the QA Chrome. Smoothness was verified at frame accuracy, not at 60fps, because the automation tab throttles requestAnimationFrame to ~1fps
